verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, rescue me from evil people. Protect me from violent people,
who plan evil in their hearts and start fights all the time.
Their tongues are as sharp as a snake's. Their words are like the poison of a viper. Selah.
LORD, keep me out of the hands of the wicked. Protect me from violent people who plan to make me trip.
Proud people have hidden a trap for me. They have spread out a net beside the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
I say to the LORD, "You are my God." LORD, hear my cry for mercy.
LORD, my Lord, my strong saviour, you protect my head on the day of battle.
LORD, do not give the wicked what they want. Do not let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
Let the heads of those who surround me be covered by the trouble their own lips have caused.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into deep muddy pits they can never climb out of.
Do not let people who tell lies about others succeed in the land. Let disaster hunt down violent people.
I know that the LORD will defend the cause of those who suffer and give justice to the poor.
Good people will surely praise your name. Honest people will live in your presence.
